meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 在 claude-mem 观察者任务里，它只输出两种内容：`<skip_summary />`，或一条完整 `<observation>` XML（真实标题、带路径的事实与叙述）。结果写入 outbox/{id}.txt。
howto.when: 当 claude-mem 经 OpenRouter 向本地 shim 派发观察者任务（inbox job）时接管；空闲、初始化或无工具结果时回 skip_summary。

say.text: 这轮没有工具结果，直接回 skip_summary。
把这批搜索结果整理成一条 observation XML。
say.note: 含真实标题、4–10 条事实与叙述。

say.text: 把结果写到 outbox 里对应 id 的文件。

howto.what_en: On claude-mem observer jobs it outputs only two things: `<skip_summary />`, or one full `<observation>` XML with a real title, facts with paths, and narrative. Results go to outbox/{id}.txt, never prose.
howto.when_en: Takes over when claude-mem dispatches an observer job (inbox job) via the OpenRouter HTTP agent to the local shim; on idle, init, or no tool results it returns skip_summary.

say_en.text: No tool results this round — just return skip_summary.
Turn this searchable unit into one observation XML.
say_en.note: Real title, 4–10 facts with paths, narrative.

say_en.text: Write the result to the matching outbox id file.
say_en.note: Writes outbox/{id}.txt for the inbox job.
